title: Holistic Reality
definition: The concept that everything in the universe is interconnected and fundamentally dependent on each other.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a spider's web. Everything connected in a complex, interdependent network. That's how reality works.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Holistic Reality refers to the interconnectedness of all phenomena in the universe, emphasizing the interdependence and mutual conditionality of all things, following concepts like dependent origination and the mycelial network.
difficulty_levels.expert: Holistic Reality is a philosophical position that reflects the complex, interconnected nature of reality. It has implications in various fields, including quantum physics, consciousness studies, and ecology. It suggests that the universe operates as a single, coherent system, with no true boundaries between elements. This challenges the traditional reductionist approach to science and promotes a more holistic understanding of the world.

extra_fields.insight: The universe is a single, interconnected system, with no true boundaries between elements.
